name: How long does a typical multi-family renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical multi-family renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a multi-family renovation project varies significantly based on its scope and scale. A minor common area refresh might take a few weeks, while a comprehensive modernization of an entire apartment complex could extend for several months, or even over a year. Factors influencing the timeline include the number of units, the extent of structural work, material lead times, necessary permitting processes, and whether tenants remain on-site during construction. Opus Builders develops detailed project schedules to keep stakeholders informed and minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; minor refreshes take weeks, while full modernizations can take months or over a year. Factors include unit count, structural work, and permitting.
